query:
INSERT INTO access.vault_release_modes
               (tenant_id, realm_id, version, mode, domain_id, decision_pos)
             SELECT $1, $2,
                    COALESCE((SELECT max(version) FROM access.vault_release_modes
                               WHERE tenant_id = $1 AND realm_id = $2), 0) + 1,
                    $3, $4, $5
